name: St. George Island
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in St. George Island?
answer_short: Yes. Franklin County lets golf carts use county roads on St. George Island, except Gulf Beach Drive. Franklin Boulevard may only be crossed.

golf_cart.roads: County roads, not Gulf Beach Dr

rules.rule: Golf carts on St. George Island county roads except Gulf Beach Dr; Franklin Blvd crossing only
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in St. George Island?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Gulf Beach Drive?
faq.a: No. Franklin County keeps golf carts off Gulf Beach Drive.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart across Franklin Boulevard?
faq.a: Yes, to cross it, but not along it.
